description: Source code for authentication-related API routes in an Express.js server, including endpoints for health check, user registration, login, current user info retrieval, and logout.

methods.name: GET /auth/echo
methods.description: Diagnostic endpoint to test connectivity and CORS, returning headers, time, and path.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates user record, activity log, and returns auth token and user info.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates user by email and password, logs activity, and returns auth token and user info.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Returns current user info based on authentication token.

methods.name: POST /auth/logout
methods.description: Logs user logout activity; stateless endpoint.
